# criblio_search_datatype (Resource)

SearchDatatype Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "criblio_search_datatype" "example" {
  id              = "test"
  lib             = "custom"
  data_format     = "ndjson"
  max_event_bytes = 65536
  min_raw_length  = 0
  search_version  = "v2"
  tags            = ""

  automatic_extraction = {
    extraction_type = "json"
  }

  timestamp_extraction = {
    type         = "auto"
    anchor_regex = "/^/"
    timezone     = "UTC"
    earliest     = "0"
    latest       = "+10years"
    scan_depth   = 150
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `automatic_extraction` (Attributes) JSON extraction configuration applied to each newline-delimited JSON event. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--automatic_extraction))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Datatype.
- `lib` (String) Library scope for the Datatype. Value is <code>custom</code> for user-defined Datatypes or <code>cribl</code> for built-in Datatypes.
- `timestamp_extraction` (Attributes) Timestamp extraction rules applied after all extractions complete. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timestamp_extraction))

### Optional

- `add_fields` (Attributes List) Computed fields to add to each event. Each entry specifies a field name and a source expression. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--add_fields))
- `additional_extractions` (Attributes List) Additional extractions applied after the primary extraction. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--additional_extractions))
- `description` (String) Brief description of the Datatype.
- `local_search` (Attributes) Configuration for lakehouse engine, such as auto-detection expressions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--local_search))
- `max_event_bytes` (Integer) Maximum event size before truncation, in bytes.
- `min_raw_length` (Integer) Minimum raw event length used when identifying the Datatype.
- `schema_map` (Attributes List) Field mappings to rename or alias extracted fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schema_map))
- `search_version` (String) Search execution version used by the Datatype.
- `should_use_data_raw` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, applies v1-style nested <code>_raw</code> JSON semantics for Cribl Lake Search v2 Datasets.
- `tags` (String) Comma-separated tags for the Datatype.

Required:

### Nested Schema for `additional_extractions`

Required:

- `delimiter` (String) Field delimiter that separates columns in delimited text.

Optional:

- `contains_header_row` (Boolean) Indicates that the source file contains a header row.
- `escape` (String) Escape character for embedded quotes or special characters.
- `field_list` (List of String) Optional list of fields to extract.
- `null_value` (String) Value substituted when a column is empty or null.
- `quote` (String) Quote character used to wrap fields that contain the delimiter.

<a id="nestedatt--timestamp_extraction"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timestamp_extraction`

Required:

- `scan_depth` (Integer) Number of characters to scan beyond the anchor before falling back to the current time.

Optional:

- `anchor_regex` (String) Regular expression that restricts where the timestamp parser scans within <code>sourceField</code>.
- `earliest` (String) Earliest allowed timestamp as a relative time string. Older parsed timestamps are clamped.
- `latest` (String) Latest allowed timestamp as a relative time string. Newer parsed timestamps are clamped.
- `source_field` (String) Event field to scan for timestamps. If omitted, the entire event payload is scanned.
- `timezone` (String) Default timezone applied when parsed timestamps do not include a timezone offset.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = criblio_search_datatype.my_criblio_search_datatype
  id = "example"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import criblio_search_datatype.my_criblio_search_datatype "example"
```
